shots.detail_en: HOOK: late night in an old 90s arcade-house walk-up; under a dim desk lamp, Mancang's father smooths crumpled banknotes one by one into a tin box, counting on an old abacus
shots.sub: 爹（喃喃）：「一张……两张……十年了，这盒子的钱，就没敢多过这个数。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG_DAD

shots.detail_en: Mancang pushes the door open carrying a roast goose dinner box, freezing at the sight of the tin box
shots.sub: 满仓：「爹！今晚吃烧鹅！咱家十年头一顿——你哪来的钱？」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Dad hides the tin behind his back, fails, then lays it open on the table
shots.sub: 爹：「你寄回来的，我一张没花。血汗钱我认，市场上的钱——烫手。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG_DAD

shots.detail_en: Inside the tin: under the crumpled notes, a yellowed newspaper clipping — the 97 TV-interview photo of Xiong Tiancheng, crossed out hard in red pen
Dad slaps the clipping on the table, hands trembling
shots.sub: 爹：「这个人上电视那天，你爹我把棺材本全填了进去。第二天，全没了。他还在电视里说——市场惩罚的是贪婪的人。乖，你爹我不贪，我只想给你娘争口气！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG_DAD

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Mancang looks at his father's hands, at the back bent for ten years
shots.sub: 满仓（低）：「爹，这不是那年的钱了。这回，是我们自己组的会。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Mancang puts a goose leg into his father's bowl and ladles him a full serving of rice for the first time
shots.sub: 满仓：「长虹哥说，散户的钱要像铁盒一样——进得来，出得去，但每一张都得对得起良心。爹，这钱干净。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Dad stares at the goose leg in his bowl, Adam's apple bobbing, eyes rimmed red
shots.sub: 爹：「……十年了。你娘走的时候，说我不中用。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG_DAD

shots.detail_en: EXPLOSIVE BEAT, 1997 flashback, imagery-only: just hands and paper slips snowing into the order window of the old trading hall, no faces shown
shots.sub: 旁白（满仓）：「我爹这个人，一辈子没求过人。他把家底全押给一个姓熊的在电视里画的梦。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Dad digs an old brass key from the bottom of the tin and presses it into Mancang's palm
shots.sub: 爹：「明天，把这盒子搬去给你们那个同盟。放着，是死的；跟着你们——爹这辈子，再信一次人。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG_DAD

shots.detail_en: Close-up: the key in Mancang's trembling palm
shots.sub: 满仓：「爹，这是你的养老钱……说好了，天塌了都不能动的。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Dad folds Mancang's fingers one by one over the key, gripping it tight
shots.sub: 爹：「所以我交给陆先生，不交给你。你满仓满仓，一激动就全仓——你爹这条老命，得放在比你稳的人手里。」
shots.speaker: MANCANG_DAD

shots.detail_en: Mancang breaks into tears-and-laughter, saluting his dad with a crooked military bow
shots.sub: 满仓：「得令！爹——不过丑话说前头，同盟的账是沈红利管的。她算账比你狠，比你还抠！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Next day war room; Hongli counts the tin money into the ledger and writes: Wang Tiezhu — pension fund — risk level: NEVER LOSE
shots.sub: 红利：「账户备注写好了——不许亏。这三个字，比什么风控条例都好使。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong stands over the ledger, staring at the three characters PENSION FUND in long silence
shots.sub: 长虹：「从今天起，同盟的钱分两堆。一堆打江山——这一堆，只许看盘子吃饭。谁动它，谁出同盟。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Changhong hand-draws one flat line at the head of the pension column — an iron bottom
shots.sub: 长虹：「这是铁底。铁底下面，我垫着。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Hongli watches the iron-bottom line, words half swallowed
shots.sub: 红利（轻声）：「你什么时候学会……给自己揽这种债了？」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Mancang hugs the now-empty tin box in the corner, crying and grinning
shots.sub: 满仓：「我爹的养老钱进了同盟——从今天起，我不是为了自己的仓在打仗了……我是为了全仓！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Night: the war-room window carries three silhouettes hunched over ledgers, neon flickering outside
shots.sub: 旁白：「翻身仗打到第三天，谁也没注意——有一把枪，已经数完了他们的名字。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: CLIFF: morning notice board in the hall, a red-headed internal notice: COUNTER CLERK SHEN HONGLI — SUSPENDED PENDING REVIEW; her work badge lifted off and set on the counter
shots.sub: 红利（平静）：「枪响了。打的是账房。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Black screen next-episode card with white bold text
shots.sub: 字幕：「账房倒了，同盟的钱——谁来看？」
shots.card: 账房倒了，同盟的钱——谁来看？
